deadline.value: Formal deadline is 1 January for Fall 2027; applications are reviewed after that until positions are filled.
deadline.quote: Applications have a formal deadline of January 1

gre_general.value: The General GRE is highly recommended but not required.
gre_general.quote: GRE General Test scores (highly recommended but not required)

toefl_min.value: Minimum TOEFL of 80 (or IELTS 6.5), which the department can waive after an interview.
toefl_min.quote: The minimum scores are officially 80 for the TOEFL or 6.5 for the IELTS

ielts_min.value: Minimum IELTS overall band of 6.5, which the department can waive after an interview.
ielts_min.quote: The minimum scores are officially 80 for the TOEFL or 6.5 for the IELTS

english_waiver.value: A TOEFL or IELTS score is required; the language requirement can be waived through an interview.
english_waiver.quote: it is also possible to get these language requirements waived through an interview process

supervisor.value: You do not need to pick a faculty advisor before admission.
supervisor.quote: It is not necessary for students to select an advisor in the mathematics faculty before being admitted

funding.value: Admitted PhD students receive free tuition and a stipend, $30,500 a year for 2026-27.
funding.quote: Students admitted to the PhD program receive free tuition, a stipend ($30,500 per year, as of the 2026-27 academic year)

entry_route.value: Students with only a bachelor's degree can apply to the PhD.
entry_route.quote: Can students with only a Bachelors Degree apply to the PhD program? | Yes. This is very common.

fee_waiver.value: The department can waive the application fee for finalists who ask.
fee_waiver.quote: finalists may request a waiver if that is needed
